description: List resource usage quotas by location.

operations.description: List resource usage quotas by location.

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description:
The URL the client should use to fetch the next page (per server side paging).
It's null for now, added for future use.
props.name: nextLink

props.description: Current value for the usage quota.
props.name: currentValue

props.description: The maximum permitted value for the usage quota. If there is no limit, this value will be -1.
props.name: limit

props.description: Localizable String object containing the name and a localized value.
props.name: name

props.description: Representing the units of the usage quota. Possible values are: Count, Bytes, Seconds, Percent, CountPerSecond, BytesPerSecond.
props.name: unit

responses.description: Success. The response describe the usage quotas of a subscription in specified region.
Error response describing why the operation failed.
